title: Move dialog: named systems and All from here
description: The tactical movement dialog names every system as #<tile number> [<name>]: the destination (#18 [Mecatol Rex]), each origin (#01 [Sol home system], #41 [Gravity rift]) and en-route pickups. Each origin has an All from here button that stages every ship there and then the fighters and ground forces its holds can carry (fighters, then the space area, then planets). It only stages: counts, cargo gauge and the Commit Moves count update, and nothing is sent until Commit Moves, which sends the same plan the manual + clicks would. Regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CL.

notes.title: Naming
notes.text: systemTag() in presentation/systemFacts.ts reads the board tile label: home tiles ("Jord - Sol") become "Sol home system", planetless tiles read by kind ("Gravity rift", "Empty system"), Mallice and the Creuss Gate keep their place name, anomalies with planets append the kind. Unknown tiles show the bare number.

notes.title: Engine answers unchanged
notes.text: All from here only fills the dialog's staging (client side). Committing goes through the existing batch path, so the steps are identical to the same manual clicks (covered by a vitest that compares both batches). No engine, option id or fingerprint change.
